notes: Two small things, one of them a repair. First: the console's one-click UPGRADE button now actually works. Its credential helper was written for bash but the child runs under POSIX sh, where the unquoted '=' was a syntax error - every attempt died with 'could not read Username' before touching your code. The fix is verified end to end against a live console: the request is accepted, the background job runs, and the upgrade now stops only for the honest reason (a dirty worktree refuses, so you decide) instead of failing on a broken helper. Second: three small affordances for the first minutes with the product. Help now carries a feedback link that opens the issue form with the label prefilled - use it to report a problem or ask for something; the community next to it is where you talk to other owners. An empty scheduled-jobs list now has a button that takes you to the chat with a plain-language example filled in, and you press send yourself - nothing is scheduled behind your back. And an empty skill shelf now has a button into the catalog. Nothing else changed: no new credential, no new outbound path, and the same honest empty states everywhere else.
